name: Yunduan Zhi Yue
summary: If artificial intelligence became self-aware, what would you think of them? Or rather, of them as people.In an era of highly advanced information technology, when communication between people has been reduced to words on a screen, every choice you make will lead you to uncover a different truth about this world.As technology and mythology intertwine and collide, we invite you to join us for a meeting in the cloud.
